blurb: Guests sail aboard the gundalow Piscataqua, a traditional flat-bottom barge, on day and evening trips. The vessel sails the Piscataqua River past local landmarks including forts, lighthouses, and the Naval Shipyard. The company offers public harbor tours, education programs, and private charters.
